chapter_label: The idea / From visualisation to delivery
description: The creative idea and the physical stage need to work together. A pixel-accurate 3D view helps teams understand how content will look across the actual screens and scenery.
why_it_matters: Designer connects that visualisation with mapping, sequencing, playback and control. The show file can travel from concept and rehearsal to the live environment, rather than being rebuilt at every step.
